name: Kaizoku Health -Moshimo Kanojo-tachi ga Fuuzokujou Nara?-
original_name: 海賊ヘルス -もしも彼女達が風俗嬢なら?-
source:
One day the protagonist and his crew arrived in a harbor being sacked by other pirates.
Irritable and tired from the long voyage he capriciously wiped out the nuisances,
and was met with gratitude by the ladies he saved... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE113136.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某天，主人公和他的船员抵达了一个正被其他海盗洗劫的港口。
因为长途航行而暴躁疲惫的他，随性地消灭了那些碍事的家伙，
被他所救的女性们满怀感激地迎接了他……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE113136.html]DLsite English[/url]]
